name: Amitifadine
summary: Amitifadine (developmental code names DOV-21,947, EB-1010) is a serotonin–norepinephrine–dopamine reuptake inhibitor (SNDRI) or so-called triple reuptake inhibitor (TRI) which is or was being developed by Euthymics Bioscience.

pharmacology.text: Amitifadine (developmental code names DOV-21,947, EB-1010) is a serotonin–norepinephrine–dopamine reuptake inhibitor (SNDRI) or so-called triple reuptake inhibitor (TRI) which is or was being developed by Euthymics Bioscience.

uses.text: Amitifadine (developmental code names DOV-21,947, EB-1010) is a serotonin–norepinephrine–dopamine reuptake inhibitor (SNDRI) or so-called triple reuptake inhibitor (TRI) which is or was being developed by Euthymics Bioscience. In September 2017, development of amitifadine for the treatment of major depressive disorder was finally officially discontinued.

sideEffects.en: In trials the reported effects included nausea, dizziness, dry mouth and headache. Its development did not continue after mixed trial results, so its long-term effects in people are not known.
sideEffects.zh: 在試驗中回報的反應包括噁心、頭暈、口乾與頭痛。由於試驗結果不一，它的開發並未繼續，因此對人體的長期影響不明。
sideEffects.zhHans: 在试验中回报的反应包括恶心、头晕、口干与头痛。由于试验结果不一，它的开发并未继续，因此对人体的长期影响不明。

fact.en: It is a triple reuptake inhibitor, designed to block the recycling of serotonin, noradrenaline and dopamine all at once, which is sometimes called a broad spectrum antidepressant approach.
fact.zh: 它是三重回收抑制劑，設計上同時阻斷血清素、正腎上腺素與多巴胺的回收，這種做法有時被稱為廣效抗憂鬱策略。
fact.zhHans: 它是三重回收抑制剂，设计上同时阻断血清素、正肾上腺素与多巴胺的回收，这种做法有时被称为广效抗忧郁策略。
